notes: JetLagged, the custom Canvas / custom layout sample. :app declares 9 @Preview functions, all catalogued; MultiDevicePreview is declared in the same module. Carries one patch, patches/0001-default-extra-colors-to-light-palette.patch: LocalExtraColors' default is an empty JetLaggedExtraColors(), and HeartRateGraph throws IllegalArgumentException (waveLineColors requires 2+ colors) when it reads it outside JetLaggedTheme. HeartRateCard and JetLaggedScreen are @Preview-annotated in place and install no theme, so without the patch HeartRateCard and all four JetLaggedScreen device previews — the whole dashboard, the catalog's hero — fail standalone, in Android Studio as well. The patch defaults the local to the light palette, one line, and is the change to offer upstream; no preview is excluded. Built from UNMODIFIED upstream android/compose-samples (main), replacing the catalog preview.coo.ee served from the yschimke/compose-samples fork: that fork's `previews` branch carried roughly ten thousand lines of catalog-only preview sources that no longer apply to upstream, and none of them is carried over — this import renders upstream's own @Preview functions only, and every spec entry names one. The Theme control comes from the sample's own theme composable via `themes` in the spec, replacing the fork's re-themed Material 3 tab. Each sample is its own Gradle build in a subdirectory of the repository, hence workingDirectory. Licence: Apache-2.0.
